extension.summary: Films and shows from Debrid Media Manager, through your own debrid or Easynews account
extension.description: Browse and search films and shows, and play the cached releases DMM knows of and what DMM members have cast, through your Real-Debrid, TorBox, AllDebrid, Premiumize, Offcloud or Debrid-Link account, and search your own Easynews account too. Link it by scanning a code with your phone: no keys to type. Sponsors also get their Wanted list.
extension.news: 1.2.0: plays from your Easynews account. Sign in to Easynews in DMM's Settings, then choose Account → Link again here; Easynews releases join the source list. 1.1.2: tells DMM which version of the addon is asking, so DMM can count how many installs have each version. Nothing about you or what you watch is sent. 1.1.1: your library shows each release's poster and the title DMM matched it to, and the source list names audio languages before the filename. 1.1.0: releases with your audio language come first, from the addon's own setting or Kodi's, and the source list names each release's audio languages where DMM knows them; you can also hide releases known to lack it. 1.0.3: what you watch scrobbles to Trakt when Kodi's Trakt addon is installed. 1.0.2: casting from your phone a release that was already listed now plays it right away. 1.0.1: search finds every title DMM knows, not only Cinemeta's popular ones. 1.0.0: first release.
